facts.statement: A community event was held in Seaside on Friday August 14, 2009, with activities including dancing, turning into crabs, fireworks, trading collections, and trivia by Community Ambassadors.
facts.quote: Everyone will be hitting the sand in Seaside to dance, turn into crabs, light fireworks, trade collections

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Seaside Beach Party - Friday August 14th
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language freerealms.com news post announcing a community beach party in Seaside on Friday August 14, 2009, from 1pm to 3pm Pacific Daylight Time on Server 1. It describes beach-themed activities hosted by Community Ambassadors and says beach outfits can be bought with Station Cash or earned in-game through quests, web codes, or vendors in Sanctuary's Pixiewood area.
